_comment: Tier-2 for febio::biphasic#1. Two wrong variants of the same material, and the claim is that they are distinguishable: a flat <E> inside `biphasic` gives 'tag "E" (line N) : unrecognized tag' and NOT a missing-property message, while deleting the nested <permeability> gives 'Component "Material1" needs to have property "permeability" defined (line N)' and NOT an unrecognized-tag message. Each message is required absent from the other run. Positive control: the shipped heat_3d_bar / biphasic_3d_confined template, unmodified, which runs to normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
